'''Marendalar''' is an island located off the coast of the [[Seanchan]] home continent. Its precise location is unknown, although at one time it was heavily populated, suggesting it must be substantial in size.

==The Marendalar Rebellion==

Some years before the ''[[Corenne]]'' was launched, Marendalar rose in rebellion against the [[Crystal Throne]]. The Seanchan [[Ever Victorious Army]] was deployed to crush the rebellion, and ''[[damane]]'' were used by both sides. After a lengthy campaign lasting over two years, the Seanchan government proved victorious. More than 30,000 people were killed in the conflict and some 1,500,000 survivors on the island were made ''[[da'covale]]'' afterwards.
